title: Optimizing Bandwidth Utilization Through Word Based Compression in Main Memories
problem: Memory compression maximizes memory capacity, lowers bandwidth requirements, and reduces energy consumption
method: Cond-FWC compresses memory blocks by analyzing cache lines—the fixed-size chunks of data moved between main memory and CPU—to identify which multi-byte words (values) appear most frequently. It eliminates these redundant words by storing them only once and replacing each occurrence with a short reference, shrinking the data size. This compression reduces the bandwidth required to transfer data between main memory and processor, lowering energy consumption.
key_novelty: The technique compresses cache lines by identifying frequently repeated words and storing them once with references instead of repeated copies.
